role: SDR / Appointment Setter, Positive Reply Follow-Up

hero.label: Made for Retell AI SDR
hero.headline: I want to sell the AI that makes SDRs obsolete.
hero.subheadline: Retell AI went from zero to eight-figure ARR in under two years by making voice agents that actually work at scale. I have spent the last year doing exactly what Retell automates, cold outreach and follow-up sequences, so I understand the problem from the inside. That perspective is what I want to bring to your pipeline.

whyCompany.title: Retell sells to the people who feel the pain most
whyCompany.body: Contact center teams and sales orgs live and die by call volume and conversion rates, and Retell replaces the most expensive, inconsistent part of that stack. That is not a vitamin, it is a painkiller with a very short sales cycle. Selling a product this concrete to buyers who already feel the cost of the status quo is a dream scenario for an SDR.

whyCompany.title: Eight-figure ARR in two years means the ICP is proven and the pipeline needs to scale now
whyCompany.body: Bing and the team have already validated that companies will pay for this, which means the SDR job right now is execution, not education. Joining at this stage means I get to build repeatable outbound motion while the category is still being defined. That window does not stay open long.

whyCompany.title: I have lived the exact workflow Retell replaces
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach and LinkedIn sequences in HubSpot that helped close 15 to 20 paying clients, so I know what a positive reply follow-up funnel looks like when it is done manually and where it breaks. At NextAfter I studied what makes B2B messaging convert across channels. I am not learning this category from a blog post, I lived it.

quote: I spent over a year doing by hand exactly what Retell does automatically, and I became a believer in the product before I ever saw the job posting. I want to be the person who puts it in front of every sales leader who is still doing it the old way.
